cohort: 3450 singleton pregnant women without comorbidities presenting for first trimester booking visits.
finding: Subclinical hypothyroidism was associated with increased risk of gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, preterm delivery, cesarean section, and intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in women with hypothyroidism compared to euthyroid women.
